Multi English · 7th Grade · Theme 3

Vocabulary Quiz

Test 1 / 3
Cevaplanan: 0 / 50

Doğru şıkkı işaretle. Cevabını değiştirebilirsin. Bitirince altta TESTİ BİTİR düğmesine bas. Menü ile başka bir teste geçebilirsin.

1Vocabulary Test 1 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Ece took a photo of herself with her phone yesterday. She held the camera in front of her own face. She sometimes takes this type of photo on trips. Her photo is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) selfie

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ece took a photo of herself with her phone yesterday. She held the camera in front of her own face. She sometimes takes this type of photo on trips.” Bu tarif “selfie” kelimesine uyar; selfie = özçekim. Diğer şıklar: traditional remedy (geleneksel çare), digital device (dijital cihaz), nutritionist (beslenme uzmanı).

2

Mert shared a short message and a photo on his account last night. His friends saw it and added comments. He shares something like this once a week. He created a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) post

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mert shared a short message and a photo on his account last night. His friends saw it and added comments. He shares something like this once a week.” Bu tarif “post” kelimesine uyar; post = gönderi. Diğer şıklar: medical test (tıbbi test), gym membership (spor salonu üyeliği), heartbeat (kalp atışı).

3

Selin chose to receive updates from an artist's account yesterday. The artist's new posts now appear in her feed. She follows several artists in the same way. Selin is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) follower

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Selin chose to receive updates from an artist's account yesterday. The artist's new posts now appear in her feed. She follows several artists in the same way.” Bu tarif “follower” kelimesine uyar; follower = takipçi. Diğer şıklar: patient (hasta), privacy setting (gizlilik ayarı), social media account (sosyal medya hesabı).

4

Bora received an invitation to connect with a classmate online. He recognised the classmate and accepted it yesterday. People send these invitations to add someone to their online contacts. He accepted a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) friend request

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Bora received an invitation to connect with a classmate online. He recognised the classmate and accepted it yesterday. People send these invitations to add someone to their online contacts.” Bu tarif “friend request” kelimesine uyar; friend request = arkadaşlık isteği. Diğer şıklar: side effect (yan etki), warning sign (uyarı işareti), workout (antrenman).

5

Duru saw a shocking story on a website yesterday. She checked the facts and discovered that the story was not true. It presented invented events as real. The story was ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) fake news

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Duru saw a shocking story on a website yesterday. She checked the facts and discovered that the story was not true. It presented invented events as real.” Bu tarif “fake news” kelimesine uyar; fake news = sahte haber. Diğer şıklar: physical activity (fiziksel etkinlik), social media addiction (sosyal medya bağımlılığı), melatonin level (melatonin seviyesi).

6

Arda needed information for his project last week. He chose a source with named experts and checked facts. He usually checks who provides information before using it. He chose a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) reliable source

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda needed information for his project last week. He chose a source with named experts and checked facts. He usually checks who provides information before using it.” Bu tarif “reliable source” kelimesine uyar; reliable source = güvenilir kaynak. Diğer şıklar: sports event (spor etkinliği), screen (ekran), doctor (doktor).

7

Elif received a request for her home address yesterday. She did not send it because she keeps such details private. Home addresses and phone numbers are examples of ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) personal information

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Elif received a request for her home address yesterday. She did not send it because she keeps such details private.” Bu tarif “personal information” kelimesine uyar; personal information = kişisel bilgi. Diğer şıklar: self-care (öz bakım), fitness (zindelik, fitness), balance (denge).

8

Can changed who could see his account photos last weekend. He selected an option that allowed only close friends to see them. These options control who sees private details. He changed his ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) privacy settings

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Can changed who could see his account photos last weekend. He selected an option that allowed only close friends to see them. These options control who sees private details.” Bu tarif “privacy settings” kelimesine uyar; privacy settings = gizlilik ayarları. Diğer şıklar: recovery (iyileşme), excessive exposure (aşırı maruz kalma), distraction (dikkat dağınıklığı).

9

Nehir did not share her friend's private message yesterday. She believes people have a right to control their personal details. Her choice protected her friend's ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) privacy

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir did not share her friend's private message yesterday. She believes people have a right to control their personal details.” Bu tarif “privacy” kelimesine uyar; privacy = gizlilik. Diğer şıklar: treatment (tedavi), restriction (kısıtlama), awareness (farkındalık).

10

Emir checked a report on his tablet last night. It showed two hours of use during the day. Such reports measure time spent looking at a display. The report showed his ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) screen time

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Emir checked a report on his tablet last night. It showed two hours of use during the day. Such reports measure time spent looking at a display.” Bu tarif “screen time” kelimesine uyar; screen time = ekran süresi. Diğer şıklar: mental tiredness (zihinsel yorgunluk), blood pressure (tansiyon), blue light (mavi ışık).

11

Sena decided not to use digital devices during her weekend trip. She read, walked and talked to her family instead. A planned break from digital technology is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) digital detox

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena decided not to use digital devices during her weekend trip. She read, walked and talked to her family instead.” Bu tarif “digital detox” kelimesine uyar; digital detox = dijital detoks. Diğer şıklar: well-being (iyi oluş, esenlik), illness (hastalık), healthcare (sağlık hizmeti).

12

Baran started building model ships last month. He uses wood and glue, and he does not need the Internet. It is something he enjoys away from a screen. It is his ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) offline hobby

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran started building model ships last month. He uses wood and glue, and he does not need the Internet. It is something he enjoys away from a screen.” Bu tarif “offline hobby” kelimesine uyar; offline hobby = çevrim dışı hobi. Diğer şıklar: online gaming habit (çevrim içi oyun alışkanlığı), medical device (tıbbi cihaz), health problem (sağlık sorunu).

13

İpek planned when to go online each day last week. She included time for homework and a clear stopping time. Her schedule helps her organise digital activities. It is an ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) internet use plan

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek planned when to go online each day last week. She included time for homework and a clear stopping time. Her schedule helps her organise digital activities.” Bu tarif “internet use plan” kelimesine uyar; internet use plan = internet kullanım planı. Diğer şıklar: online game (çevrim içi oyun), antibiotic (antibiyotik), electronic device (elektronik cihaz).

14

Tolga chose a maximum of thirty minutes for a game yesterday. He stopped when the timer rang. A maximum time allowance prevents an activity from continuing without an end. He decided to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) set time limits

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga chose a maximum of thirty minutes for a game yesterday. He stopped when the timer rang. A maximum time allowance prevents an activity from continuing without an end.” Bu tarif “set time limits” kelimesine uyar; set time limits = süre sınırı koymak. Diğer şıklar: use reliable sources (güvenilir kaynaklar kullanmak), lose focus (odağını kaybetmek), walk up the stairs (merdivenleri yürüyerek çıkmak).

15

Eylül used social media for three hours on Monday and one hour on Tuesday. She chose a shorter online session on Tuesday. Her aim was to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) reduce screen time

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül used social media for three hours on Monday and one hour on Tuesday. She chose a shorter online session on Tuesday.” Bu tarif “reduce screen time” kelimesine uyar; reduce screen time = ekran süresini azaltmak. Diğer şıklar: check your phone (telefonunu kontrol etmek), miss an exam (sınavı kaçırmak), drink water regularly (düzenli su içmek).

16

Ozan visited his cousin yesterday. They sat in the same room, talked and looked at each other instead of using a screen. Their conversation was ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) face-to-face communication

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan visited his cousin yesterday. They sat in the same room, talked and looked at each other instead of using a screen.” Bu tarif “face-to-face communication” kelimesine uyar; face-to-face communication = yüz yüze iletişim. Diğer şıklar: overuse (aşırı kullanım), social isolation (sosyal izolasyon), screen addiction (ekran bağımlılığı).

17

Cemre read a message that said a website might be unsafe. She stopped and checked with her teacher before continuing. Such a message points to possible danger. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) warning sign

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre read a message that said a website might be unsafe. She stopped and checked with her teacher before continuing. Such a message points to possible danger.” Bu tarif “warning sign” kelimesine uyar; warning sign = uyarı işareti. Diğer şıklar: morning jog (sabah koşusu), natural remedy (doğal çare), fitness challenge (fitness yarışması).

18

Yusuf joined a school discussion about safe Internet use last week. He learnt to notice risks that he previously ignored. Recognising and understanding those risks shows ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) awareness

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Yusuf joined a school discussion about safe Internet use last week. He learnt to notice risks that he previously ignored.” Bu tarif “awareness” kelimesine uyar; awareness = farkındalık. Diğer şıklar: health (sağlık), balanced diet (dengeli beslenme), diet (beslenme düzeni).

19

Melis divided her free time between friends, schoolwork and digital activities yesterday. No single activity took all her time. She wants a suitable mix in her life. She values ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) balance

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Melis divided her free time between friends, schoolwork and digital activities yesterday. No single activity took all her time. She wants a suitable mix in her life.” Bu tarif “balance” kelimesine uyar; balance = denge. Diğer şıklar: nutrition (beslenme), conscious internet use (bilinçli internet kullanımı), relaxation (rahatlama).

20

Aras often checked his phone during homework. Yesterday, each alert pulled his attention away from the task. Something that takes attention away is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) distraction

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aras often checked his phone during homework. Yesterday, each alert pulled his attention away from the task.” Bu tarif “distraction” kelimesine uyar; distraction = dikkat dağınıklığı. Diğer şıklar: restriction (kısıtlama), screen time (ekran süresi), melatonin level (melatonin seviyesi).

21

Sıla spent the whole weekend away from her usual friends. She missed having someone to talk to. A person who wants company but feels alone often feels ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) lonely

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sıla spent the whole weekend away from her usual friends. She missed having someone to talk to.” Bu tarif “lonely” kelimesine uyar; lonely = yalnız. Diğer şıklar: sleepless (uykusuz), motivated (istekli, motive olmuş), focused (odaklanmış).

22

Gökçe completed her school project yesterday. She smiled, spoke brightly and enjoyed the afternoon. She is usually positive and full of good spirits. Yesterday, she felt ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) cheerful

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Gökçe completed her school project yesterday. She smiled, spoke brightly and enjoyed the afternoon. She is usually positive and full of good spirits.” Bu tarif “cheerful” kelimesine uyar; cheerful = neşeli. Diğer şıklar: excited (heyecanlı), inviting (davetkâr, cazip), dizzy (başı dönen).

23

Defne worried about several deadlines last night. She felt under pressure and found it hard to relax. Too many demands sometimes make her feel ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) stressed

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Defne worried about several deadlines last night. She felt under pressure and found it hard to relax.” Bu tarif “stressed” kelimesine uyar; stressed = stresli. Diğer şıklar: worried (endişeli), hydrated (yeterince su almış), relaxed (rahatlamış).

24

Kerem finished all three tasks on his list yesterday. He used his time well and produced useful work. A day with good results like these is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) productive

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Kerem finished all three tasks on his list yesterday. He used his time well and produced useful work.” Bu tarif “productive” kelimesine uyar; productive = üretken. Diğer şıklar: unhealthy (sağlıksız), nutritious (besleyici), isolated (yalnız kalmış, kopuk).

25

Buse worked carefully on one maths problem yesterday. She ignored the noise around her and kept her attention on the task. She did not lose concentration. She stayed ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) focused

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Buse worked carefully on one maths problem yesterday. She ignored the noise around her and kept her attention on the task. She did not lose concentration.” Bu tarif “focused” kelimesine uyar; focused = odaklanmış. Diğer şıklar: exhausted (bitkin), energetic (enerjik), sleepless (uykusuz).

Vocabulary Test 1 · Sonuç
0/ 100 puan
✔ Doğru: 0✘ Yanlış: 0○ Boş: 0

Her soru 4 puan. Yanlış ya da boş bir soruya tıkla; o soruya gidip doğrusunu ve Türkçe çözümünü gör.

2Vocabulary Test 2 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Deniz followed the same order before school last week. He got up, washed, ate breakfast and left home at regular times. He usually follows this pattern on school days. It is his ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) daily routine

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Deniz followed the same order before school last week. He got up, washed, ate breakfast and left home at regular times. He usually follows this pattern on school days.” Bu tarif “daily routine” kelimesine uyar; daily routine = günlük rutin. Diğer şıklar: post (gönderi), medical device (tıbbi cihaz), online gaming habit (çevrim içi oyun alışkanlığı).

2

İdil chose different types of food for her meals yesterday. Her choices included vegetables, fruit, grains and protein foods. She values variety rather than eating only one food group. She prefers a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) balanced diet

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İdil chose different types of food for her meals yesterday. Her choices included vegetables, fruit, grains and protein foods. She values variety rather than eating only one food group.” Bu tarif “balanced diet” kelimesine uyar; balanced diet = dengeli beslenme. Diğer şıklar: treatment (tedavi), recovery (iyileşme), healthcare (sağlık hizmeti).

3

Onur spoke to a trained food specialist yesterday. They discussed his usual meals and eating patterns. This professional works with food choices and nutrition. Onur visited a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) nutritionist

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Onur spoke to a trained food specialist yesterday. They discussed his usual meals and eating patterns. This professional works with food choices and nutrition.” Bu tarif “nutritionist” kelimesine uyar; nutritionist = beslenme uzmanı. Diğer şıklar: reliable source (güvenilir kaynak), doctor (doktor), traditional remedy (geleneksel çare).

4

Zeynep completed a form at a sports centre last month. She paid to use its exercise facilities regularly. Her card now allows her to enter the gym. She has a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) gym membership

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Zeynep completed a form at a sports centre last month. She paid to use its exercise facilities regularly. Her card now allows her to enter the gym.” Bu tarif “gym membership” kelimesine uyar; gym membership = spor salonu üyeliği. Diğer şıklar: natural remedy (doğal çare), health condition (sağlık durumu), fitness challenge (fitness yarışması).

5

Arda walked, cycled and played basketball last weekend. These activities involved moving his body. He likes activities that keep him moving. They are forms of ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) physical activity

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda walked, cycled and played basketball last weekend. These activities involved moving his body. He likes activities that keep him moving.” Bu tarif “physical activity” kelimesine uyar; physical activity = fiziksel etkinlik. Diğer şıklar: screen addiction (ekran bağımlılığı), privacy (gizlilik), overuse (aşırı kullanım).

6

Mina ran slowly through the park before breakfast yesterday. She enjoys this activity early in the day. It is not an evening workout or a game. She went for a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) morning jog

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mina ran slowly through the park before breakfast yesterday. She enjoys this activity early in the day. It is not an evening workout or a game.” Bu tarif “morning jog” kelimesine uyar; morning jog = sabah koşusu. Diğer şıklar: friend request (arkadaşlık isteği), screen (ekran), privacy setting (gizlilik ayarı).

7

Ali did not use the lift yesterday. He went from one floor to the next on foot. He often chooses this route in buildings. He likes to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) walk up the stairs

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ali did not use the lift yesterday. He went from one floor to the next on foot. He often chooses this route in buildings.” Bu tarif “walk up the stairs” kelimesine uyar; walk up the stairs = merdivenleri yürüyerek çıkmak. Diğer şıklar: accept a friend request (arkadaşlık isteğini kabul etmek), spread fake news (sahte haber yaymak), pay attention to a warning (bir uyarıyı dikkate almak).

8

Pelin ate breakfast, lunch and dinner yesterday. She did not leave out any of her usual meals. Leaving out a meal means deciding to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) skip meals

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Pelin ate breakfast, lunch and dinner yesterday. She did not leave out any of her usual meals.” Bu tarif “skip meals” kelimesine uyar; skip meals = öğün atlamak. Diğer şıklar: set time limits (süre sınırı koymak), join a gym (spor salonuna yazılmak), check your phone (telefonunu kontrol etmek).

9

Efe went to bed early and slept for the time he needed last night. He woke up ready for school. He normally plans bedtime carefully. He tries to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) get enough sleep

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Efe went to bed early and slept for the time he needed last night. He woke up ready for school. He normally plans bedtime carefully.” Bu tarif “get enough sleep” kelimesine uyar; get enough sleep = yeterince uyumak. Diğer şıklar: drink water regularly (düzenli su içmek), ignore homework (ödevi görmezden gelmek), lose focus (odağını kaybetmek).

10

Derya stayed awake until two in the morning yesterday. She read messages long after her usual bedtime. Remaining awake until a late hour means choosing to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) stay up late

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Derya stayed awake until two in the morning yesterday. She read messages long after her usual bedtime.” Bu tarif “stay up late” kelimesine uyar; stay up late = geç saatlere kadar uyanık kalmak. Diğer şıklar: change habits (alışkanlıkları değiştirmek), send a text (mesaj göndermek), avoid exercise (egzersizden kaçınmak).

11

Berk checked the clock and left home at the right time yesterday. He arrived after the lesson began because the bus broke down. He does not usually arrive late. Yesterday, he was ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) late for school

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Berk checked the clock and left home at the right time yesterday. He arrived after the lesson began because the bus broke down. He does not usually arrive late.” Bu tarif “late for school” kelimesine uyar; late for school = okula geç kalmış. Diğer şıklar: unhealthy (sağlıksız), relaxed (rahatlamış), nutritious (besleyici).

12

Sena did not attend an important test yesterday. She arrived after the test finished and did not answer any questions. Failing to attend a test means that you ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) miss an exam

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena did not attend an important test yesterday. She arrived after the test finished and did not answer any questions.” Bu tarif “miss an exam” kelimesine uyar; miss an exam = sınavı kaçırmak. Diğer şıklar: use reliable sources (güvenilir kaynaklar kullanmak), stay fit (formda kalmak), stay healthy (sağlıklı kalmak).

13

Burak worked all day and walked a long distance yesterday. By evening, he had almost no energy left. He felt much more than a little tired. He was ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) exhausted

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Burak worked all day and walked a long distance yesterday. By evening, he had almost no energy left. He felt much more than a little tired.” Bu tarif “exhausted” kelimesine uyar; exhausted = bitkin. Diğer şıklar: isolated (yalnız kalmış, kopuk), productive (üretken), sleepless (uykusuz).

14

Eda received an invitation to a special sports event yesterday. She could hardly wait for it and talked about it eagerly. She usually enjoys new experiences. She felt ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) excited

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eda received an invitation to a special sports event yesterday. She could hardly wait for it and talked about it eagerly. She usually enjoys new experiences.” Bu tarif “excited” kelimesine uyar; excited = heyecanlı. Diğer şıklar: cheerful (neşeli), lonely (yalnız), motivated (istekli, motive olmuş).

15

Tuna read quietly in the garden yesterday. His worries faded, and he felt calm rather than tense. Quiet time helps him feel ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) relaxed

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tuna read quietly in the garden yesterday. His worries faded, and he felt calm rather than tense.” Bu tarif “relaxed” kelimesine uyar; relaxed = rahatlamış. Diğer şıklar: inviting (davetkâr, cazip), hydrated (yeterince su almış), worried (endişeli).

16

Cem chose a meal with useful vitamins, minerals and protein yesterday. It gave his body several important nutrients. Food that supplies useful nutrients is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) nutritious

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cem chose a meal with useful vitamins, minerals and protein yesterday. It gave his body several important nutrients.” Bu tarif “nutritious” kelimesine uyar; nutritious = besleyici. Diğer şıklar: dizzy (başı dönen), stressed (stresli), energetic (enerjik).

17

Aylin took time for her own needs yesterday. She rested, enjoyed a hobby and followed her normal hygiene routine. Caring for your own well-being is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) self-care

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aylin took time for her own needs yesterday. She rested, enjoyed a hobby and followed her normal hygiene routine.” Bu tarif “self-care” kelimesine uyar; self-care = öz bakım. Diğer şıklar: awareness (farkındalık), relaxation (rahatlama), excessive exposure (aşırı maruz kalma).

18

Eren wanted to improve his habits last month. He compared different choices and selected one plan. Choosing between options means that you ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) make a decision

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eren wanted to improve his habits last month. He compared different choices and selected one plan.” Bu tarif “make a decision” kelimesine uyar; make a decision = karar vermek. Diğer şıklar: reduce screen time (ekran süresini azaltmak), sign up for a membership (üyelik için kaydolmak), spend time outdoors (açık havada vakit geçirmek).

19

Nehir rarely went outside last term. Last week, she started taking a short walk after school instead. Replacing an old routine with a different one means that you ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) change habits

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir rarely went outside last term. Last week, she started taking a short walk after school instead.” Bu tarif “change habits” kelimesine uyar; change habits = alışkanlıkları değiştirmek. Diğer şıklar: share personal information (kişisel bilgi paylaşmak), play online games (çevrim içi oyun oynamak), accept a friend request (arkadaşlık isteğini kabul etmek).

20

Baran was ill last week, but he feels better now. He gradually returned to his usual activities. Becoming well again is called ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) recovery

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran was ill last week, but he feels better now. He gradually returned to his usual activities.” Bu tarif “recovery” kelimesine uyar; recovery = iyileşme. Diğer şıklar: health (sağlık), blue light (mavi ışık), face-to-face communication (yüz yüze iletişim).

21

İpek went to a clinic yesterday. A qualified professional examined her and discussed her health. This professional diagnoses illnesses and provides medical care. İpek saw a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) doctor

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek went to a clinic yesterday. A qualified professional examined her and discussed her health. This professional diagnoses illnesses and provides medical care.” Bu tarif “doctor” kelimesine uyar; doctor = doktor. Diğer şıklar: workout (antrenman), follower (takipçi), social media account (sosyal medya hesabı).

22

Tolga waited in a clinic yesterday. He went there to receive medical care from a doctor. A person who receives such care is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) patient

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga waited in a clinic yesterday. He went there to receive medical care from a doctor.” Bu tarif “patient” kelimesine uyar; patient = hasta. Diğer şıklar: selfie (özçekim), health problem (sağlık sorunu), side effect (yan etki).

23

Eylül saw equipment during a hospital visit yesterday. It helped staff measure a health condition. Equipment designed for medical use is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) medical device

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül saw equipment during a hospital visit yesterday. It helped staff measure a health condition.” Bu tarif “medical device” kelimesine uyar; medical device = tıbbi cihaz. Diğer şıklar: digital device (dijital cihaz), warning sign (uyarı işareti), medical test (tıbbi test).

24

Ozan placed his hand over his chest after a running game yesterday. He noticed a regular beat. Each beat is part of the heart's rhythm. This is his ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) heartbeat

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan placed his hand over his chest after a running game yesterday. He noticed a regular beat. Each beat is part of the heart's rhythm.” Bu tarif “heartbeat” kelimesine uyar; heartbeat = kalp atışı. Diğer şıklar: internet use plan (internet kullanım planı), online game (çevrim içi oyun), account feature (hesap özelliği).

25

Cemre saw an unwanted reaction listed on a medicine leaflet yesterday. The leaflet explained that this reaction was separate from the intended benefit. An unwanted additional reaction is called a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) side effect

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre saw an unwanted reaction listed on a medicine leaflet yesterday. The leaflet explained that this reaction was separate from the intended benefit.” Bu tarif “side effect” kelimesine uyar; side effect = yan etki. Diğer şıklar: sports event (spor etkinliği), privacy setting (gizlilik ayarı), health condition (sağlık durumu).
